Journey: The Disciples' Journey to Galilee after the Resurrection
Summary: After the resurrection the risen Jesus told the women to tell his brothers to go into Galilee, and there on a mountain the eleven saw him, worshipped, and received the commission to make disciples of all nations. Matthew does not name the mountain, so no mountain stage is given.
Significance: Galilee closes the circle: the place of calling becomes the place of commissioning to the whole world.
